entries.note: This manifest itself: versioned, schema-shaped, and validated like every other data file.
The nine-worlds role definitions as data (Y-012): hats, ceilings and expected capabilities.
The mesh's named enemies as data (Y-010); SIMULATED paperwork - it names controls, it does not claim them built.

note: Data discipline (Y-016): every registry, catalog, profile and policy in this repo is a versioned data file registered here, with its schema and its validator. A data file that is not registered here fails validation; a registered file whose on-disk version, roadmap slice or items disagree with this manifest fails validation. The manifest registers itself first. Profiles and policies do not exist as data yet - the first one lands by adding its entry here, in the same slice that creates it.
